source.name: Rob Run Guide
source.note: Community fan guide. States the catalog uses data extracted from game files. Not affiliated with Kefir / ROB RUN.
source.costNote: Reference values come from the files for this build. Unlock costs include dirty cash and materials. Coins are tracked separately, and ordering a shipment has its own cost.
limitations: Values come from the local game configuration. The live server and its progress were not queried.
These values show the unlock costs. In-game charges have yet to be observed. Ordering and delivery costs are separate.
The total starts from scratch, includes every prerequisite, and counts each shared unlock once. The guide cannot read your progress.
The layout is adapted for the browser. Connections follow the game requirements, and reference values can vary by server configuration.
